title: Verification of new members
state_on: On: every new member gets a captcha before seeing the server.
state_off: Off: new members get in right away.
state_paused: Paused: Premium has ended for this server.
state_incomplete: Pick at least one role below to make it work.
state_blocked: On, but a role below needs fixing: new members get in without a captcha.
phVrole: Verified role: given once the captcha is passed
phUrole: Waiting role: hides the server until then
hint: Roles that would give too much power are refused. The waiting role is hidden from every channel except the panel.
premiumNeeded: Verification is a Premium feature ({priceUsd} a month). See the plans with /premium status.
nUrole: Waiting role set to {role}. Channels now hidden from it: {n}.
nLockFailed: Channels I couldn't change: {n} (my role must be above it).
nNoPanel: No panel yet, so {channel} stays open for members with closed DMs. Post a panel to close it.
nNoPanelNone: No panel and no system channel: members with closed DMs can't verify. Post a panel.
nSame: The verified role and the waiting role must be different.
nNeedRole: Pick at least one role first.
guard_everyone_not_allowed: @everyone can't be used, pick or create a dedicated role
guard_managed_role: it belongs to a bot or an integration, pick a regular role
guard_dangerous_perms: it has {perms}: remove that in Server Settings → Roles
guard_above_bot: it's above my role: drag ARCHON's role higher in Server Settings → Roles
guard_above_actor: it's at or above your own highest role
cantPost: I couldn't post in {ch}. Check that I can see it and send messages there.
panelIntro: To keep this server safe, new members show they're human before getting in.
panelStep2: Type the 6 characters from the picture.
panelStep3: That's it: the server opens up.
panelNote: {n} tries per code, then a short pause.
chHint: Capital or small letters, it doesn't matter · try {n} of {max} · ends {when}
wrongNew: Not quite, here's a new code.
notActive: Verification isn't active on this server.
notConfigured: Verification isn't set up yet. Ask an admin to run /verify.
misconfigured: Verification needs fixing by an admin (/verify) before it can let you in.
memberNotFound: I couldn't find you on this server. Try again in a moment.
cooldown: Wait {secs} more seconds before asking for a new code.
codeExpired: This code has expired. Press Start on the panel for a new one.
codeOutdated: That's an old code: use the latest one.
tooManyPanel: 3 wrong codes. Take a breath and try again in 30 seconds.
dmIntro: Type the 6 characters from the picture here to get into **{server}**.
dmTries: {n} tries · capital or small letters, it doesn't matter
dmStuckPanel: Stuck? The panel in {channel} gives you a new code.
dmStuck: Stuck? Ask a moderator of the server.
dmHint: That doesn't look like a code: type the 6 characters from the picture. This one didn't count.
okText: Welcome to **{server}**. All its channels are open to you now.
rolesFailText: I couldn't open **{server}** for you: my role is probably too low. The moderators have been told; type the code again once they've fixed it.
failPanel: Get a new code from the panel on **{server}**.
failNoPanel: Ask a moderator of **{server}** for help.
kickTimeout: The {mins} minutes to verify ran out.
kickBack: You can come back and try again with a new code.
oldBtnPanel: This button is no longer used: verify in {channel}.
oldBtnRejoin: This button is no longer used: leave and rejoin the server to get a new code.
log_roles_failed: {user} gave the right code, but I couldn't change their roles: {error}
log_spam: {user} joined {n} times in 10 minutes: no more captchas for now
cantPostPrivate:
⛔ I can't post in {ch} yet — that channel is private, and I'm not on its list.

**To fix it (about 10 seconds):**
1. Open the channel → **Add members or roles** (or Edit Channel → Permissions)
2. Add **{bot}**
3. Turn on **View Channel**, **Send Messages** and **Embed Links**
4. Run {cmd} again
cantPostRoleBlock:
⛔ I can't post in {ch} — {role} is blocking me there.

**To fix it:**
1. Edit Channel → Permissions
2. **Add the {bot} role** and allow **{perms}** — leave {role} alone, changing it would open the channel to everyone
3. Run {cmd} again
cantPostMissingPerm:
⛔ My role is missing **{perms}** at the server level, so I can't post in {ch}.

**To fix it:**
1. Server Settings → Roles → **{bot}**
2. Turn on **{perms}**
3. Run {cmd} again

_Still failing? This channel may also be private — add {bot} to its permissions as well._
cantPostGone: ⛔ I can't find {ch} anymore. Pick another channel.
cantPostWrongType: ⛔ I can't post the verification panel in {ch}: it's a forum, a media channel or a category. Pick a text channel.
cantPostThreadLocked: ⛔ {ch} is a locked thread. Unlock it or give **{bot}** **{perms}**.
cantPostTimeout: ⛔ I'm timed out on this server, so I can't post anything. Right-click **{bot}** in the member list, remove its timeout, then try again.
